# Wellbeing outcomes (forest therapy / Rhythm2Recovery / Rhythm2School)

Evolves a model that predicts post-session wellbeing scores from pre-session
scores and session parameters, for programs such as forest therapy sessions
or Rhythm2Recovery / Rhythm2School drumming programs. Uses your real
pre/post survey data if you have it — `sample_data.csv` here is entirely
**synthetic placeholder data**, generated by `generate_sample_data.py`, only
so the pipeline can be smoke-tested without real data.

## What this does and does not do

- It **evolves a predictive/statistical model** against your existing
  pre/post survey data, scored with cross-validated R² (how well session
  factors explain the variance in outcomes) — this is the "predict" /
  "measure" part.
- `suggest_protocol.py` uses that fitted model to **grid-search** over
  feasible protocol parameters (duration, frequency, program type) and rank
  which combination the model predicts will maximize improvement — this is
  the "optimize" part.
- It does **not** run a clinical trial, does not establish causality, and
  does not replace proper study design, statistical review, or ethical
  oversight. Treat its output as a hypothesis-generation and exploration
  tool on top of data you already collected — validate anything
  consequential with a real analysis and, where relevant, a qualified
  statistician/researcher before acting on it.

## Your data schema

A CSV with one row per participant (or per session), containing at least:

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `participant_id` | unique identifier |
| `program` | e.g. `forest_therapy`, `rhythm2recovery`, `rhythm2school` |
| `pre_score` | wellbeing/stress/mood score before the intervention |
| `post_score` | same scale, after the intervention |

Plus any numeric covariates you have (`session_duration_min`,
`session_frequency_per_week`, `age`, `group_size`, biomarkers, etc.) — the
seed model picks up all numeric columns automatically, and Claude can evolve
better feature engineering as it iterates.

Point the evaluator at your real file:

```bash
export ALPHAEVOLVE_DATA_CSV=/path/to/your_real_data.csv
```

If unset, it falls back to the bundled synthetic `sample_data.csv`.

## Run it

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
export ALPHAEVOLVE_DATA_CSV=/path/to/your_real_data.csv   # omit to use synthetic sample data

python -m alphaevolve.cli \
  examples/wellbeing_outcomes/initial_program.py \
  examples/wellbeing_outcomes/evaluator.py \
  --config configs/example.yaml \
  --task "Improve build_and_predict() so it better predicts post_score from pre_score, program, and session parameters, generalizing across cross-validation folds rather than overfitting." \
  --iterations 30 \
  --output out/wellbeing_outcomes \
  -v
```

Then ask "which protocol looks best?":

```bash
python examples/wellbeing_outcomes/suggest_protocol.py \
  out/wellbeing_outcomes/best_program.py \
  /path/to/your_real_data.csv
```
